text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with modest overnight losses, while altcoins like BNB are showing slightly more weakness, suggesting risk-off positioning. The Fear & Greed index is deeply in fear territory at 27 with no momentum shift over the past week, indicating sustained caution rather than panic capitulation. Bitcoin's dominance at 56.3% paired with relatively light $46B daily volume points to a consolidating market where traders are largely sitting on the sidelines.
